verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a handful of first-party npm packages and tools: the engine, React and Web Components bindings, PCUI, SplatTransform, and the create-playcanvas starters. Nothing documents an asset store, a marketplace of ready-made models, or a third-party plugin ecosystem. superspl.at hosts published splat scenes for viewing, not a store of reusable assets, so it does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a game developer, a large asset store or package ecosystem gives me ready-made models, tools, and plugins
